personal.name: Maya Lin
personal.title: Lead UX/UI Designer
personal.about: Lead UX/UI Designer with 8 years of experience crafting intuitive digital products for B2B and B2C companies. Skilled in user research, interaction design, and design systems. Proven track record of increasing conversion rates and user satisfaction through data-informed design decisions.

experience.description:
Leading a design team of 5, establishing design standards and workflows for a SaaS platform with 200K+ users
Created a comprehensive design system with 120+ components, reducing design-to-development handoff time by 40%
Conducted usability studies that informed a checkout redesign, resulting in a 28% increase in conversion
Collaborated closely with product and engineering to define and prioritize the design roadmap

Designed core features for the collaboration workspace used by 30M+ users globally
Led the redesign of the mobile experience, increasing mobile DAU by 45%
Facilitated design sprints and workshops with cross-functional stakeholders

Designed end-to-end experiences for 10+ early-stage startups across fintech, health, and education
Built wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups using Figma and Sketch

education.description: Minor in Computer Science. Senior thesis on accessible interface design.
